function Source(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(s) = 5;
  s[0] = 0.0;
  s[1] = 0.0;
  s[2] = 0.0;
  s[3] = 0.0;
  s[4] = 0.0;
end

function Tdfunc(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(m) = 5;
  m[0] = 1.0;
  m[1] = 1.0;
  m[2] = 1.0;
  m[3] = 1.0;
  m[4] = 1.0;
end

function Ubou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(ub) = 15;
  ub[0] = uq[0];
  ub[1] = uq[1];
  ub[2] = uq[2];
  ub[3] = uq[3];
  ub[4] = uq[4];
  ub[5] = uq[0];
  ub[6] = 0.0;
  ub[7] = 0.0;
  ub[8] = 0.0;
  ub[9] = (mu[9]*mu[11]*uq[0])/mu[10];
  ub[10] = 0.0;
  ub[11] = 0.0;
  ub[12] = 0.0;
  ub[13] = 0.0;
  ub[14] = 0.0;
end

function Fbou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 20;

function FbouHdg(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 30;
  fb[0] = mu[4]-uhat[0];
  fb[1] = mu[5]-uhat[1];
  fb[2] = mu[6]-uhat[2];
  fb[3] = mu[7]-uhat[3];
  fb[4] = mu[8]-uhat[4];
  fb[5] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[6] = uq[1]-uhat[1];
  fb[7] = uq[2]-uhat[2];
  fb[8] = uq[3]-uhat[3];
  fb[9] = uq[4]-uhat[4];
  fb[10] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[11] = -uhat[1];
  fb[12] = -uhat[2];
  fb[13] = -uhat[3];
  fb[14] = -uhat[4]+(mu[9]*mu[11]*uhat[0])/mu[10];
  fb[15] = n[0]*uq[5]+n[1]*uq[10]+n[2]*uq[15]+tau[0]*(uq[0]-uhat[0]);
  fb[16] = n[0]*uq[6]+n[1]*uq[11]+n[2]*uq[16]+tau[0]*(uq[1]-uhat[1]);
  fb[17] = n[0]*uq[7]+n[1]*uq[12]+n[2]*uq[17]+tau[0]*(uq[2]-uhat[2]);

function Initu(x, eta, mu)
  output_size(ui) = 5;
  ui[0] = mu[4];
  ui[1] = mu[5];
  ui[2] = mu[6];
  ui[3] = mu[7];
  ui[4] = mu[8];
end
